summary: Added prepaid-expense-amortization variant to financial-rollforward-workbook skill, capturing the key structural differences: amortization terminology (Adds/Amortization instead of Accruals/Utilization), control row naming (Month Totals instead of Period Totals), and the correct Variance formula pattern (=O{gl}-N{ending} for column O variance). This prevents future agents from misapplying rebate-reserve patterns to prepaid expense schedules.
